description:
Reid Osprey 1 | Road bike
Lightweight, responsive and built for the open road – an ideal entry-level road bike for discovering road cycling, improving fitness, commuting and enjoying longer rides.
The Reid Bikes Osprey 1 is designed to make road cycling more accessible, combining a lightweight aluminium frame with practical components and reliable performance at an affordable price. Whether you're new to cycling, looking for a bike to support your fitness goals or ready to explore further afield, the Osprey 1 from Reid Bikes offers a capable and comfortable introduction to road riding.
At its core is a lightweight aluminium frame, engineered to deliver a responsive ride without unnecessary weight. Internal cable routing creates a clean, streamlined appearance, while the alloy straight-blade fork provides stable and predictable handling. Quick-release dropouts make wheel removal straightforward, adding everyday practicality to the bike's design.
A 14-speed LTWOO drivetrain provides a versatile range of gearing for tackling climbs, maintaining momentum on flat roads and adapting to changing gradients. The 2x7-speed setup combines a 50/34T compact alloy chainset with a 14-28T freewheel, giving riders a choice of gears for different road conditions. LTWOO integrated shifters feature ergonomic brake hoods, allowing convenient gear changes while keeping your hands comfortably positioned and close to the brakes.
The Reid Bikes Osprey 1 road bike features Kenda Kriterium 700x30c road tyres, offering a balance of rolling efficiency, comfort and grip. The wider tyre profile helps provide additional cushioning and stability compared with narrower traditional road tyres, making everyday road surfaces and longer rides more comfortable. Paired with 700c double-wall alloy rims and quick-release hubs, the wheelset provides a practical and dependable setup for regular road cycling.
Dual-pivot caliper brakes deliver reliable stopping power and controlled braking, while compact alloy drop handlebars offer multiple hand positions to suit different riding styles and conditions. Finished with comfortable bar tape, a sport saddle and alloy platform pedals, the Osprey 1 is equipped with the essentials for getting out and enjoying the road.
With its lightweight aluminium construction, versatile gearing and road-focused design, the Reid Bikes Osprey 1 is a great starting point for riders looking to develop their cycling experience. From everyday fitness rides and commuting to weekend road adventures, it's built to help you ride further and discover the enjoyment of road cycling.
The Reid Bikes Osprey 1 is ideal for:

Beginner road cyclists, with an affordable introduction to road cycling and a lightweight aluminium frame

Fitness and recreational cycling, with a responsive design suited to regular exercise and improving riding fitness

Everyday commuting, with efficient 700c wheels, practical gearing and a comfortable road-focused setup

Longer road rides, with ergonomic shifter hoods, comfortable bar tape and a sport saddle

Tackling hills and varied gradients, with a 14-speed LTWOO drivetrain and 50/34T compact chainset

Efficient road riding, with Kenda Kriterium 700x30c tyres designed to balance rolling efficiency, comfort and grip

Responsive and predictable handling, with a lightweight 6061 aluminium frame and alloy straight-blade fork

Convenient gear changes, with LTWOO integrated shifters combining shifting and braking controls

Reliable braking performance, with dual-pivot caliper brakes for controlled stopping on paved roads

Riders looking for an affordable first road bike, combining practical components, lightweight construction and excellent value for everyday cycling and weekend adventures
